title: Aggressive conference and opposing-unit strength adjustment – exploratory 2026 Week 6
method: For PO,RO,PD,RD remove prior conference point adjustment, apply new stronger conference point adjustment, plus opposing matched-unit pregame rank premium. Premium=12*(31-rank)/30 if opponent unit rank<=30, otherwise zero. Aggregate = 65% best top-30 unit faced + 35% average bonus across matched games (including zeroes). Offense/Defense equal mean of adjusted units. Overall = baseline overall + 0.55*average change in offense and defense scores.
limitations: Matched pregame ranks include Weeks 2-6 only; Week 1 excluded.
Premium for facing good units does not independently measure actual performance against that unit, although baseline performance does.
Potential double counting because baseline units were already opponent adjusted.
No out-of-sample calibration or formal prediction validation; cannot claim this is more accurate.
